answer: Make Sybil identities costly by requiring a nontransferable bond locked through a full review cycle. Independent graders release it only after consistent, honest participation and slash proven collusion. An operator opening many accounts must finance every bond, accept the opportunity cost of immobilized capital, and risk proportional forfeiture. Track bond age and overlapping grader links, with an appeal path for honest newcomers. This keeps a spiral of disposable identities from riding a gale of free attempts, while marble-hard rules remain reviewable.
